name: LangSmith
tagline: MCP-Native Eval vs LangChain Ecosystem Tracing
oneLine: LangChain's framework-agnostic observability and evaluation platform for agents, instrumented via the langsmith SDK; self-hosting is Enterprise-only.
tldrVendor: LangSmith is LangChain's observability and evaluation platform with integrations for many frameworks and providers, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and HIPAA compliance; self-hosting is an Enterprise-plan add-on. If you need advanced evaluation workflows, Insights auto-clustering, or enterprise compliance today, LangSmith is the more established platform.

rows.quote: Use @traceable in Python, traceable in TypeScript and Kotlin, and Tracing.traceFunction in Java.
Self-hosted LangSmith is an add-on to the Enterprise plan designed for our largest, most security-conscious customers.

rows.vendor: Async tracing via SDK in your process
rows.quote: LangSmith processes runs in a background thread, which does not block your application.
LLM-as-judge evaluators use LLMs to score application outputs.

rows.vendor: Token counts and computed cost per LLM call and per trace; latency per run
rows.quote: Token counts enable cost calculation, which LangSmith displays in the Tracing Projects UI.

rows.vendor: MCP server reads runs, projects, datasets, experiments (run_experiment is docs-only); Agent Server exposes MCP + A2A
rows.quote: run_experiment Documentation-only: how to run experiments and evaluations in LangSmith.

rows.vendor: Built and operated by LangChain, Inc. (company founded early 2023; venture-backed)
rows.quote: Harrison teamed up with co-founder Ankush Gola to start LangChain, the company, in early 2023
Insights automatically analyzes your traces to detect usage patterns, common agent behaviors, and failure modes, so you do not need to review thousands of traces manually.

rows.vendor: LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, OpenTelemetry + more
rows.quote: LangSmith provides integrations for a growing set of popular LLM providers and agent frameworks

rows.vendor: Versioned prompts (a commit per save, movable tags) and a Playground
rows.quote: Every saved update to a prompt creates a new commit with a unique commit hash.

rows.vendor: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR; custom SSO, RBAC/ABAC, self-hosted/hybrid deployment, support SLA
rows.quote: We maintain SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance and undergo annual third-party audits and penetration testing.

faq.question: What is the difference between Iris and LangSmith?
faq.vendorPart: LangSmith is LangChain's observability and evaluation platform, instrumented with @traceable decorators and SDK wrappers and integrated with many frameworks; self-hosting is an Enterprise-plan add-on. LangSmith provides LLM-as-judge and human evaluation workflows, Insights auto-clustering, and SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and HIPAA compliance.

faq.question: Is Iris better than LangSmith for MCP agent evaluation?
faq.vendorPart: LangSmith requires @traceable decorators or SDK wrappers but offers LLM-as-judge evaluation, human review through annotation queues, and native LangChain and LangGraph integration.
